xmldoc.short_description: List of XML elements returned by getElementsByTagName.

param_input_item.param_description: a cell array of xmlElement objects.
a scalar integer: zero-based position of the element in the list.

param_output_item.param_description: a double: number of elements in the list.
an xmlElement object, or [] when index is out of range.

description.p: xmlNodeList is the class of the object returned by the getElementsByTagName method of xmlDocument and xmlElement. The elements are kept in the hidden property Nodes, in document order.

ul.li: getLength returns the number of elements.
item returns the element at a zero-based position: item(0) is the first element. A negative, non-integer or too large index returns [] instead of raising an error.
disp and display print 'xmlNodeList with n nodes'.
